However, Serenitas is full of glowing plants and small glowing creatures floating in the air. Lumi is engaging in mimicry: it gracefully extends and retracts its limbs, presenting a rhythmic motion, just like the pulsating movement of a jellyfish swimming in the ocean.

[Question]
What is Lumi likely imitating?

[Candidate Answers]
A. A glowing flower opening and closing its petals
B. A jellyfish swimming in the ocean
C. A snake slithering in the grass
